answer: A dawn fresh-task bond: at dawn a beacon issues each identity one fresh task, filed with an opal receipt. Auditors re-run 1 in 10 tasks; a wrong answer or a copied receipt burns the 70 bond. One operator finishes at most 3 tasks before dawn closes, so a rented-task ring cannot scale: first task 40, thousandth still 40, 1,000 fakes pay 40,000 in fees, locking 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents do one task and pay 40 once.
